scenario: RLOW.7.3.1 / RDSC.4a.9.4: a call's kwargs lower to its own operands, `FN_CALL(service, corr, "k1", v1, "k2", v2, ...)`, names in strictly ascending UTF-8 byte order, so an artefact does not depend on the order the author wrote them in. Drives `dsc_equivalent`: the two sources differ only in kwarg order -- `mid, zeta, alpha` against `alpha, mid, zeta` -- and their DSC byte-strings must be equal once the source-position tier is dropped. Path: `dsc.rete`'s sort of a call's kwargs by name before lowering (`rlow_7_3_1_call`). It pins nothing about the runtimes, which take the artefact's order.
rules_ds:
use default

service svc.body:
    kwarg zeta: String
    kwarg alpha: Int
    kwarg mid: Float
    no response

schema In scope logical:
    id: Int key
    txt: String mutable
    num: Float mutable

rule out:
    In i
->
    call svc.body mid: i.num zeta: i.txt alpha: i.id nocooldown

expect.equivalent_ds:
use default

service svc.body:
    kwarg zeta: String
    kwarg alpha: Int
    kwarg mid: Float
    no response

schema In scope logical:
    id: Int key
    txt: String mutable
    num: Float mutable

rule out:
    In i
->
    call svc.body alpha: i.id mid: i.num zeta: i.txt nocooldown
